title: Political Mayhem in Britain and Italy

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Two battles over the meaning of democracy are now playing out in Europe.
sentences.zh: 关于民主含义的两场争端目前正在欧洲上演。

sentences.en: So, Katrin, previously on The Daily, you told us the story of populism in Europe over five parts, and now it feels like that story is very much back in the news.
sentences.zh: 那么，卡特琳，此前在《每日新闻》中，你用五个部分给我们讲述了欧洲民粹主义的故事，现在感觉这个故事又重新回到了新闻头条。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So, we've got news out of the UK.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们有了来自英国的新闻。

sentences.en: We've got news out of Italy.
sentences.zh: 我们有了来自意大利的新闻。

sentences.en: I'm sort of just waiting for the other countries to sort of implode.
sentences.zh: 我有点像是在等着其他国家也逐一陷入崩溃。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's been quite a week.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真是戏剧性的一周。

sentences.en: So, let's start with the UK.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从英国开始。

sentences.en: Remind us where we were when this week started.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下这周开始时我们的处境如何。

sentences.en: Good evening from Downing Street, where Boris Johnson, one of the most controversial politicians of modern times, has taken over as Prime Minister from Theresa May.
sentences.zh: 从唐宁街向您致以晚安，现代最受争议的政治家之一鲍里斯·约翰逊已从特蕾莎·梅手中接任首相职务。

sentences.en: Standing in Downing Street for the first time as Prime Minister Boris Johnson promised the British people that Brexit will be dealt with in 99 days.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯·约翰逊首次以首相身份站在唐宁街，向英国人民承诺，英国脱欧将在99天内得到解决。

sentences.en: And he's promised to take Britain out of the EU on October 31st, with or without a deal.
sentences.zh: 并且他承诺在10月31日带领英国退出欧盟，无论有没有达成协议。

sentences.en: I and all ministers are committed to leaving on this date, whatever the circumstances, and to do otherwise, would cause a catastrophic loss of confidence in our political system.
sentences.zh: 我和所有大臣都致力于在这一日期脱欧，无论情况如何，如果不这样做，将导致我们的政治体系失去信心，造成灾难性的后果。

sentences.en: Okay, so the situation is that Boris Johnson needs to deliver Brexit finally.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以现在的形势是鲍里斯·约翰逊需要最终实现脱欧。

sentences.en: We've got a deadline, October 31St.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个截止日期，即10月31日。

sentences.en: You know, the deadline was extended twice.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个截止日期已经延长了两次。

sentences.en: This now seems to be the hard deadline.
sentences.zh: 现在这似乎是最后的死线了。

sentences.en: And he's got nine weeks to deliver this promise to take Britain out of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 他有九周的时间来兑现带领英国退出欧盟的承诺。

sentences.en: Basically, there are two ways of doing that.
sentences.zh: 基本上，有两种方法可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: Either you cut a deal with Brussels, with the other 27 countries in the European Union, and figure out a way to make this kind of work seamlessly.
sentences.zh: 要么你与布鲁塞尔以及欧盟其他27个国家达成协议，并想出一个办法让这种过渡顺利进行。

sentences.en: Or you don't cut a deal, in which case you kind of crash out of this block, meaning that you have a situation of total chaos.
sentences.zh: 要么你达不成协议，在这种情况下，你就会无协议硬脱欧，这意味着你将陷入彻底混乱的局面。

sentences.en: This no-deal Brexit scenario is basically something that most lawmakers want to avoid.
sentences.zh: 这种无协议脱欧的方案基本上是大多数议员想要避免的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's why there were scenes of Theresa May trying and failing to pass a deal Brexit through Parliament over and over again in these really embarrassing stumbles.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么会出现特蕾莎·梅一次又一次地试图在议会通过脱欧协议却屡屡失败的场景，那些尴尬的绊脚石。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: She failed three times, and then she resigned.
sentences.zh: 她失败了三次，然后她辞职了。

sentences.en: And now Boris Johnson has made it very clear that he stands for a Brexit on October 31St.
sentences.zh: 现在鲍里斯·约翰逊已经非常明确地表明，他主张在10月31日脱欧。

sentences.en: Do or die, as he put it.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，不成功便成仁。

sentences.en: And we're going to fulfill the repeated promises of Parliament to the people.
sentences.zh: 我们将兑现议会对人民的再三承诺。

sentences.en: Deal or no deal.
sentences.zh: 无论有没有协议。

sentences.en: And come out of the EU on October 31St.
sentences.zh: 并在10月31日退出欧盟。

sentences.en: That's his objective.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的目标。

sentences.en: No ifs or buts.
sentences.zh: 没有如果，也没有但是。

sentences.en: So, this was kind of the situation we were in.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们当时所处的状况。

sentences.en: Everybody was wondering, what's he going to do with this?
sentences.zh: 每个人都在想，他会对这个局面做些什么？

sentences.en: And then he did something that nobody expected.
sentences.zh: 然后他做了一件谁也没有料到的事。

sentences.en: He suspended Parliament.
sentences.zh: 他让议会休会了。

sentences.en: It is a move that will make it easier for Johnson to force the country's exit from the European Union without a deal in place.
sentences.zh: 此举将使约翰逊更容易在没有达成协议的情况下强行推动该国退出欧盟。

sentences.en: Critics say this is a constitutional crisis, but supporters say it's standard practice.
sentences.zh: 批评人士称这是一场宪法危机，但支持者称这是标准做法。

sentences.en: What does that actually mean?
sentences.zh: 这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: So, he's dealing with a Parliament that not only hasn't been able to agree on anything, there's no majority for any deal that has been proposed.
sentences.zh: 所以，他面对的议会不仅无法在任何事情上达成一致，对于任何提出的协议也没有多数支持。

sentences.en: He's dealing with a Parliament that tried to oust him at one point.
sentences.zh: 他面对的议会曾在某个时刻试图赶他下台。

sentences.en: And he's dealing with a Parliament where various opposition parties are now finally making common cause to basically pass legislation to stop a no-deal Brexit from happening.
sentences.zh: 他面对的议会中，各个反对党现在终于走到了一起，共同通过立法来阻止无协议脱欧的发生。

sentences.en: Which would limit his options and basically risk for him not to be able to deliver on his promise, which is Brexit, come what may.
sentences.zh: 这将限制他的选择，并基本上让他面临无法兑现脱欧承诺的风险，无论发生什么。

sentences.en: So, there's this thing called proroguing.
sentences.zh: 所以，有这么一个东西叫“休会”（proroguing）。

sentences.en: It's a very British thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常具有英国特色的事情。

sentences.en: If you prorogue Parliament, you basically suspend it temporarily.
sentences.zh: 如果你让议会休会，基本上就是将其暂时中止。

sentences.en: And he's basically cut down the time that Parliament has in session to debate Brexit from five weeks to less than three weeks.
sentences.zh: 他基本上把议会开会辩论脱欧的时间从五周缩短到了不到三周。

sentences.en: By cutting the timetable, Johnson is making it much less likely that these people will actually come to an agreement.
sentences.zh: 通过缩短时间表，约翰逊使得这些人真正达成协议的可能性大大降低。

sentences.en: And get in his way.
sentences.zh: 从而不来碍他的事。

sentences.en: And get in his way.
sentences.zh: 从而不来碍他的事。

sentences.en: In a way, he's made it almost impossible for anyone to challenge his promise to leave the European Union on October 31St.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他几乎让任何人都不可能挑战他在10月31日离开欧盟的承诺。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Johnson is trying to severely limit the role of the legislative branch of the British government in what is arguably the most consequential process it has gone through in decades.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊正试图严重限制英国政府立法部门在可以说是几十年来经历的最具决定性的进程中的作用。

sentences.en: How on earth is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这到底怎么可能？

sentences.en: The crazy thing is it's totally possible.
sentences.zh: 疯狂的是，这完全可能。

sentences.en: Most people think it's entirely within the bounds of Britain's famously unwritten constitution.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为这完全在英国著名的不成文宪法的范围之内。

sentences.en: And he got it approved by the Queen.
sentences.zh: 而且他得到了女王的批准。

sentences.en: And that allowed him to go ahead.
sentences.zh: 这让他得以继续推进。

sentences.en: So, that's all it takes.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是全部流程了。

sentences.en: Ask the Queen.
sentences.zh: 问问女王。

sentences.en: Suspend Parliament.
sentences.zh: 暂停议会。

sentences.en: That's all it takes.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部所需。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, does that mean the Queen supports this plan?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否意味着女王支持这个计划？

sentences.en: No, it doesn't mean that she supports it.
sentences.zh: 不，这并不意味着她支持。

sentences.en: It's basically a formality in Britain.
sentences.zh: 这在英国基本上只是一种形式。

sentences.en: That part is normal.
sentences.zh: 那部分是正常的。

sentences.en: But what isn't normal is the timing.
sentences.zh: 但正常的是时机。

sentences.en: And the way that he sort of did this in a way that looks very much politically motivated.
sentences.zh: 以及他这样做的方式看起来非常具有政治动机。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is not necessarily illegal.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这不一定是非法的。

sentences.en: There may be legal challenges, but a lot of people think he'll get away with it.
sentences.zh: 可能会有法律诉讼，但许多人认为他能逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: But it's sneaky.
sentences.zh: 但这很卑鄙。

sentences.en: And it's kind of undermining trust in the institutions and reinforcing the sense that democracy is not working.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上削弱了对机构的信任，并加剧了民主正在失效的感觉。

sentences.en: And that could become a self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 而这可能会成为一种自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: So, he's kind of playing with fire.
sentences.zh: 所以，他有点在玩火。

sentences.en: It's extremely brazen.
sentences.zh: 这极其厚颜无耻。

sentences.en: And I wonder how people, especially people who serve in Parliament, have responded.
sentences.zh: 我想知道人们，尤其是议员们，是如何反应的。

sentences.en: They're not happy.
sentences.zh: 他们很不高兴。

sentences.en: People basically accuse him of staging a coup.
sentences.zh: 人们基本上指责他发动了一场政变。

sentences.en: Shutting down Parliament in order to force through an ideal Brexit, which will do untold and lasting damage to the country, against the wishes of MPs, is not democracy.
sentences.zh: 为了强行通过一项会对国家造成不可估量的持久损害的无协议脱欧，不顾议员们的意愿而关闭议会，这不是民主。

sentences.en: It's dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 这是独裁。

sentences.en: They say he's acting like a king.
sentences.zh: 他们说他的行为就像个国王。

sentences.en: He's taking away fundamental democratic rights and disabling Parliament.
sentences.zh: 他在剥夺基本的民主权利并瘫痪议会。

sentences.en: Suspending Parliament is not acceptable.
sentences.zh: 暂停议会是不可接受的。

sentences.en: It's not on.
sentences.zh: 这太不像话了。

sentences.en: What the prime minister is doing is a sort of smash and grab on our democracy.
sentences.zh: 首相正在做的事情是对我们民主的一种强取豪夺。

sentences.en: People have been marching in the streets.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在街头游行。

sentences.en: The bottom line of all of this is that people are saying this is deeply undemocratic.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切的底线是，人们说这是极其不民主的。

sentences.en: It's not for an unelected prime minister to shut down the elected parliament to ram through a no deal for which he has no democratic mandate.
sentences.zh: 一个未经选举产生的首相没有权力关闭通过民选产生的议会，来强行通过一个他没有民主授权的无协议脱欧。

sentences.en: I mean, the scale of what he's doing strikes me as the equivalent of the president of the United States in the middle of the immigration debate, for example.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他所做事情的规模，在我看来相当于美国总统在移民辩论期间。

sentences.en: Something as divisive as Brexit.
sentences.zh: 就像脱欧这样具有分裂性的事情。

sentences.en: Just somehow suspending Congress and putting his plan for a border wall in action and saying, I don't need you.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么地暂停国会，并将他修建边境墙的计划付诸实施，然后说，我不需要你们。

sentences.en: You're in the way.
sentences.zh: 你们在碍事。

sentences.en: It's not a bad analogy because Johnson is saying, I'm not undemocratic.
sentences.zh: 这个类比并不算坏，因为约翰逊在说，我不反民主。

sentences.en: You guys are.
sentences.zh: 你们才是。

sentences.en: And I suspect that's probably what Trump would say.
sentences.zh: 我猜这大概也是特朗普会说的话。

sentences.en: He'd say, the people voted for me.
sentences.zh: 他会说，人民投票选了我。

sentences.en: I promised a wall.
sentences.zh: 我承诺要修墙。

sentences.en: So this is democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是民主。

sentences.en: Well, Johnson is basically saying, the people voted for Brexit.
sentences.zh: 好吧，约翰逊基本上是在说，人民投票支持了脱欧。

sentences.en: So I'm the man to deliver it.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是实现这一目标的人。

sentences.en: And if parliament is going to stand in the way, then parliament is undemocratic.
sentences.zh: 如果议会要阻挠，那么议会就是不民主的。

sentences.en: It has become clear that there are pessimists at home and abroad who think, after three years of indecision, that this country has become a prisoner to the old arguments of 2016.
sentences.zh: 很明显，国内外的悲观主义者认为，经过三年的犹豫不决，这个国家已经成了2016年旧争论的囚徒。

sentences.en: And in this home of democracy, we are incapable of honoring a democratic mandate.
sentences.zh: 在这座民主的发源地，我们无力兑现民主的授权。

sentences.en: It's pretty classic popular stuff, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实是很经典的民粹主义言论。

sentences.en: You know, the evil elites, they're not standing for the people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些邪恶的精英，他们不代表人民。

sentences.en: But here I am, the man to represent the people.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我，代表人民的人。

sentences.en: And so I am standing before you today to tell you, the British people, that those critics are wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天站在你们面前告诉你们，英国人民，那些批评者是错的。

sentences.en: The doubters, the doomsters, the gloomsters, they are going to get it wrong again.
sentences.zh: 那些怀疑论者、悲观主义者、唱衰者，他们又将大错特错。

sentences.en: The people who bet against Britain are going to lose their shirts because we're going to restore trust in our democracy.
sentences.zh: 那些与英国对赌的人将会输得精光，因为我们将恢复对我们民主的信任。

sentences.en: So Johnson is saying, you're calling it undemocratic for me to block parliament's ability to do my job.
sentences.zh: 所以约翰逊是在说，你们认为我阻止议会行使职责是不民主的。

sentences.en: But I say it's undemocratic for parliament to get in the way of me realizing what the people voted directly for, which is Brexit.
sentences.zh: 但我要说的是，议会阻挠我实现人民直接投票支持的目标——也就是脱欧，这才是真正的民主。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that's kind of where we're at.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这就是我们目前的处境。

sentences.en: It's like, what's your definition of democracy?
sentences.zh: 这就好比，你对民主的定义是什么？

sentences.en: Is it democratic to disable temporarily a legislative chamber that is sort of at the core of representative democracy, right?
sentences.zh: 暂时剥夺一个作为代议制民主核心的立法机构的权力，这算民主吗？

sentences.en: That people vote for these representatives to stand for their interests.
sentences.zh: 人们投票选出这些代表来代表他们的利益。

sentences.en: But there's this rift right now, and this is kind of at the heart of this issue of rising populism across Europe that we touched on in June as well,
sentences.zh: 但现在存在这种裂痕，这也正是我们在6月份也提到过的欧洲各地民粹主义抬头这一核心问题所在，

sentences.en: is the people don't trust their representatives anymore.
sentences.zh: 那就是人们不再信任他们的代表。

sentences.en: There's this crisis of representative democracy.
sentences.zh: 这里存在着代议制民主的危机。

sentences.en: And in Britain, the oldest democracy in the world, this tension has now really come to a head.
sentences.zh: 而在世界上最古老的民主国家英国，这种紧张局势现在真正达到了白热化。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's one of the reasons that the British people voted to get out of the EU in the first place, this idea that the European Union was not properly representing them.
sentences.zh: 这也是英国人民当初投票脱欧的原因之一，他们认为欧盟没有适当地代表他们。

sentences.en: And this is where, in some ways, the irony lies, because Boris Johnson argued in favor of Brexit precisely with the argument that it would reinforce the British parliament.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，讽刺之处也正在于此，因为鲍里斯·约翰逊当年支持脱欧的论点恰恰是它将巩固英国议会。

sentences.en: They say we have no choice but to bow down to Brussels.
sentences.zh: 他们说我们除了向布鲁塞尔低头别无选择。

sentences.en: We say they are woefully underestimating this country and what it can do.
sentences.zh: 我们说他们严重低估了这个国家及其能力。

sentences.en: It would repatriate powers.
sentences.zh: 它将收回权力。

sentences.en: It would make the British parliament more powerful and more democratic.
sentences.zh: 它将使英国议会变得更加强大、更加民主。

sentences.en: I mean, he basically argued, when he was arguing in favor of Brexit,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在支持脱欧的时候基本上辩称，

sentences.en: that Brussels was dominating too much, that Brussels was dictating to Britain,
sentences.zh: 布鲁塞尔的主导地位太强，布鲁塞尔在对英国发号施令，

sentences.en: that Brussels was sort of curtailing British sovereignty and the sort of ability of the British parliament to legislate.
sentences.zh: 布鲁塞尔在某种程度上削弱了英国的主权以及英国议会立法的能力。

sentences.en: And now he is curtailing the power of the British parliament to legislate.
sentences.zh: 而现在他却在削弱英国议会的立法权力。

sentences.en: If we vote please, we can take back control of our borders, of huge sums of money,
sentences.zh: 如果我们投票赞成，我们就能夺回对我们边界的控制权，对巨额资金的控制权，

sentences.en: 10 billion pounds a year net of our tax-raising powers, of our trade policy, and of our whole law-making system, the democracy that is the foundation of our prosperity.
sentences.zh: 每年扣除税收筹集权力后的净额100亿英镑，对我们贸易政策的控制权，以及我们整个法律制定系统的控制权——这个构成我们繁荣基础的民主制度。

sentences.en: And now he's suspending it.
sentences.zh: 而现在他却在暂停它。

sentences.en: So, Katrin, what are we expecting to actually happen now as a result of this move by the prime minister?
sentences.zh: 那么，卡特琳，作为首相这一举动的结果，我们现在实际上期待发生什么？

sentences.en: So, right from the start, Brexit has been an incredibly complicated issue, super fraud and impossible to predict the outcome.
sentences.zh: 所以，从一开始，脱欧就是一个极其复杂的问题，极具欺骗性且结果无法预测。

sentences.en: I would say that, in the broadest possible terms, what Boris Johnson has done
sentences.zh: 我想说，从最广泛的意义上讲，鲍里斯·约翰逊所做的事情

sentences.en: has significantly increased the chances of Britain leaving the European Union on October 31St.
sentences.zh: 大幅增加了英国在10月31日离开欧盟的可能性。

sentences.en: And it has probably also increased the chances of it leaving without a deal.
sentences.zh: 这也可能增加了无协议脱欧的可能性。

sentences.en: Now, he is gambling, and it's a high-stakes gamble, that he will terrify everybody so much about his utter intention to leave without a deal, if necessary,
sentences.zh: 现在他在进行一场高风险的赌博，他要让所有人无比惊恐，以为他坚决会在必要时无协议脱欧，

sentences.en: that the European Union might just give him that concession that eluded Theresa May,
sentences.zh: 以至于欧盟可能会作出特雷莎·梅未能获得的妥协，

sentences.en: and that Parliament will pass whatever deal he presents to them
sentences.zh: 并且议会会通过他提交的任何协议，

sentences.en: just to avoid the incredibly damaging and disruptive scenario of a no-deal Brexit.
sentences.zh: 仅仅为了避免无协议脱欧带来极其有害和混乱的局面。

sentences.en: But if a no-deal Brexit happens, then that might be not just a big blow to Britain's economy, but given what Boris Johnson just has done, to Britain's democracy too.
sentences.zh: 但如果无协议脱欧发生，那不仅对英国经济是一个沉重打击，而且鉴于鲍里斯·约翰逊刚刚所做的事，对英国的民主也是如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅时报才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验时报一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, Katrin, we were just talking about the messy situation in the UK.
sentences.zh: 好的，卡特琳，我们刚才在谈论英国混乱的局势。

sentences.en: What is happening in Italy?
sentences.zh: 意大利正在发生什么？

sentences.en: So this is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: Basically, we have kind of an exact inversion of the situation that we just talked about in the UK.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们看到了与刚才谈到的英国局势完全相反的情况。

sentences.en: We have a situation where it's kind of Parliament taking control in order to keep a populist from taking power.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了一种由议会接管控制权，以阻止民粹主义者夺权的情况。

sentences.en: So recall that in Italy, there's this hard-right figure,
sentences.zh: 所以请记住，在意大利，有这样一位极右翼人物，

sentences.en: Matteo Salvini,
sentences.zh: 马泰奥·萨尔维尼，

sentences.en: who has become enormously popular for being anti-immigrant and stopping migrants from landing on Italy's shores.
sentences.zh: 他因反移民以及阻止移民在意大利海岸登陆而变得极其受欢迎。

sentences.en: He's been part of a coalition government.
sentences.zh: 他曾是联合政府的一部分。

sentences.en: He was interior minister.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任内政部长。

sentences.en: And during his time in government has become even more popular.
sentences.zh: 在他执政期间，他变得更加受欢迎。

sentences.en: So he had this idea.
sentences.zh: 所以他有了这个想法。

sentences.en: He basically wanted to force the collapse of his own government in order to force a new election and then become prime minister.
sentences.zh: 他基本上想强行导致自己的政府倒台，以便强行举行新选举，然后成为总理。

sentences.en: So he thought that he had become so popular while in this position that if there were to be a new election, he would win it and become prime minister.
sentences.zh: 因此他认为，自己在担任这个职务期间变得如此受欢迎，如果举行新选举，他会赢并成为总理。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And his opponents in Parliament thought he was right.
sentences.zh: 而他在议会中的反对者认为他是对的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They thought he would probably win it.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他可能会赢。

sentences.en: Italy's government has descended into chaos.
sentences.zh: 意大利政府已经陷入混乱。

sentences.en: Which is why...
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么……

sentences.en: Giuseppe Conti abruptly tendered his resignation today after days of political infighting, adding a new level of...
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩·孔特在经历数日的政治内斗后，于今天突然宣布辞职，增添了新的一层……

sentences.en: Two very unlikely partners.
sentences.zh: 两个非常不可能的盟友。

sentences.en: Italy's opposition Democrats in the Five Star Movement have been scrambling to try and forge a viable coalition.
sentences.zh: 意大利反对党民主党与五星运动一直在争先恐后地试图组建一个可行的联盟。

sentences.en: Two parties that had been kind of sworn enemies until just a few days ago wanted to make sure that this election would never happen.
sentences.zh: 直到几天前还是死敌的两个政党，想要确保这场选举永远不会发生。

sentences.en: Two rival parties, the Five Star Movement and Democratic Party, discussed who should get what ministerial poSt.
sentences.zh: 两个竞争政党，五星运动党和民主党，讨论了谁应该得到什么部长职位。

sentences.en: So they kind of negotiated a new coalition government that would not include his party.
sentences.zh: 所以他们协商组建了一个不包括他所在政党的新联合政府。

sentences.en: A seismic shift in Italy's political landscape.
sentences.zh: 意大利政治格局的翻天覆地变化。

sentences.en: The established center-left Democratic Party and Italy's anti-establishment Five Star Movement have agreed to put aside their differences and join forces to form a government.
sentences.zh: 老牌的中左翼民主党和意大利反建制的五星运动党已同意抛开分歧，联合起来组建政府。

sentences.en: So he's been sidelined.
sentences.zh: 所以他被边缘化了。

sentences.en: By his own maneuver.
sentences.zh: 由于他自己的策略。

sentences.en: Salvini is furious, accusing Brussels, Berlin...
sentences.zh: 萨尔维尼愤怒不已，指责布鲁塞尔、柏林……

sentences.en: But also by a parliament
sentences.zh: 但也受到一个议会的阻挠，

sentences.en: that, as it would argue, in a bid to save Italian democracy from a populist who was going to go into coalition with an even more populist far-right party,
sentences.zh: 正如议会所辩称的那样，此举旨在从一个准备与更极右翼民粹政党结盟的民粹主义者手中拯救意大利民主，

sentences.en: would basically prevent a new election.
sentences.zh: 这基本上会阻止一场新的选举。

sentences.en: They would prevent giving the Italian people a vote at this moment.
sentences.zh: 他们将阻止在这个时刻赋予意大利人民投票权。

sentences.en: The new coalition is united against a common enemy.
sentences.zh: 新联盟团结起来对抗共同的敌人。

sentences.en: It will need to hold firm to keep Salvini at bay.
sentences.zh: 它需要坚定立场以遏制萨尔维尼。

sentences.en: So this is kind of wild political bed-hopping.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种非常荒谬的政治投机倒把。

sentences.en: And did it work?
sentences.zh: 这起作用了吗？

sentences.en: It worked, at least for now.
sentences.zh: 起作用了，至少目前如此。

sentences.en: So basically we have a situation where Salvini has been sidelined.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上我们遇到了萨尔维尼被边缘化的情况。

sentences.en: He's no longer in government.
sentences.zh: 他不再在政府中。

sentences.en: He has lost his ministerial poSt.
sentences.zh: 他失去了部长职位。

sentences.en: And a powerful platform to sort of do this continuous campaigning that he's been doing.
sentences.zh: 以及一个开展他一直在进行的这种持续竞选活动的强大平台。

sentences.en: You know, his opponents hope that this will basically reduce his popularity and that come the next election, which is formally scheduled in three years,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的对手希望这能基本上降低他的人气，并且在按计划三年后举行的下一次选举到来时，

sentences.en: he won't be as powerful and popular as he is now.
sentences.zh: 他将不像现在这样强大和受欢迎。

sentences.en: Of course, there are a lot of wild cards in this because his narrative, of course, is
sentences.zh: 当然，这里面有很多变数，因为他的叙事当然是

sentences.en: the establishment is afraid of the people.
sentences.zh: 建制派害怕人民。

sentences.en: The establishment is afraid of new elections.
sentences.zh: 建制派害怕新的选举。

sentences.en: The establishment is afraid of democracy.
sentences.zh: 建制派害怕民主。

sentences.en: That is what Matteo Salvini would say.
sentences.zh: 这就是马泰奥·萨尔维尼会说的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In his mind, he was the most powerful leader with the people of Italy, and he was just ousted by the politicians in parliament.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，他是意大利人民中最有领袖魅力的人，而他只是被议会里的政客赶下台的。

sentences.en: That's the story he tells.
sentences.zh: 这就是他讲述的故事。

sentences.en: And it's a powerful story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很有说服力的故事。

sentences.en: And so the question is, how does this play out?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，这会如何收场？

sentences.en: Is he going to be a kind of political has-been who, deprived of his ministerial platform,
sentences.zh: 他会成为那种失去了部长平台的政治过气人物吗？

sentences.en: will indeed lose popularity and kind of vanish from the scene?
sentences.zh: 他真的会失去人气并从政坛消失吗？

sentences.en: Or will he turn into this populist martyr?
sentences.zh: 还是他会变成这个民粹主义烈士？

sentences.en: You know, this guy who, more now than ever before, will represent the kind of frustrated ambitions of the people to have their voice heard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个比以往任何时候都更能代表人们希望听到自己声音的受挫雄心的人。

sentences.en: And therefore, in three years, could be even more popular than ever.
sentences.zh: 因此，三年后，他可能会比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 这是可能的。

sentences.en: So again, there's two ways of looking at what's democratic here, just as there was in the UK.
sentences.zh: 所以同样，看待这里什么才是民主有两种方式，就像英国一样。

sentences.en: One is that Italy's parliament protected democracy by blocking the ascent of a populist with authoritarian leanings.
sentences.zh: 一种是意大利议会通过阻止具有威权倾向的民粹主义者上台，保护了民主。

sentences.en: The other is that that leader, Salvini, is the man of the people.
sentences.zh: 另一种是那位领袖萨尔维尼是人民的人。

sentences.en: And that parliament, this time, staged a kind of undemocratic coup.
sentences.zh: 而议会这次发动了一场不民主的政变。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So parliament would say they did this to save Italian democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以议会会说他们这样做是为了拯救意大利民主。

sentences.en: But another way of looking at it is that they saved themselves.
sentences.zh: 但另一种看法是他们拯救了他们自己。

sentences.en: So Katrin, what do we make of these two stories unfolding in the exact same week?
sentences.zh: 所以卡特琳，我们该如何看待在同一周发生的这两个故事？

sentences.en: Yeah, so who would have thought only two weeks ago that we'd be talking about a situation in Italy that is actually relatively calm?
sentences.zh: 是的，谁会想到仅仅在两周前，我们会谈论一个实际上相对平静的意大利局势？

sentences.en: You know, you've got a social democratic party, a pro-European sort of establishment party in power, instead of this kind of hard right firebrand.
sentences.zh: 你知道，掌权的是一个社会民主党、一个亲欧洲的建制派政党，而不是这种强硬的右翼狂热分子。

sentences.en: And who would have thought that the prime minister of Britain would subvert parliament and, you know, the world's oldest democracy?
sentences.zh: 谁会想到英国首相会颠覆议会和世界上最古老的民主制度？

sentences.en: But this is kind of what the battle looks like, right, between the establishment and the populists.
sentences.zh: 但这就是斗争的样子，对吧，在建制派和民粹主义者之间。

sentences.en: And it's playing out everywhere, in every single country, in its own way, at different levels, in different intensities.
sentences.zh: 它在各处上演，在每一个国家，以其自己的方式，在不同的层面，不同的强度下。

sentences.en: And everybody thinks they're on the right side of democracy.
sentences.zh: 每个人都认为自己站在民主正确的一边。

sentences.en: That's kind of the striking thing, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点惊人，对吧？

sentences.en: Everybody thinks they're representing democracy.
sentences.zh: 每个人都认为自己代表了民主。

sentences.en: And where we will end, where we will land in the end, is kind of the big question of Europe right now.
sentences.zh: 我们最终会走向何方，落脚于何处，是目前欧洲最大的问题。

sentences.en: Katrin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Bye, Michael.
sentences.zh: 再见，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Thursday, as fallout from Boris Johnson's suspension of parliament intensified, two of his government allies resigned.
sentences.zh: 周四，随着鲍里斯·约翰逊暂停议会带来的余波加剧，他政府中的两名盟友辞职了。

sentences.en: Ruth Davidson, the head of the Scottish wing of the Conservative Party, and George Young, the government whip in the House of Lords.
sentences.zh: 保守党苏格兰分支负责人鲁思·戴维森，以及上议院政府党鞭乔治·扬。

sentences.en: In his resignation letter, Young made clear he could not tolerate Johnson's maneuver, writing that it, quote, risks undermining the fundamental role of parliament
sentences.zh: 扬在辞职信中明确表示，他无法容忍约翰逊的策略，写道此举“有可能破坏议会的根本作用”，

sentences.en: at a critical time in our history.
sentences.zh: 在我们历史的关键时刻。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Trump administration laid out a plan to reduce the regulation of methane emissions, a major contributor to climate change.
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普政府出台了一项旨在减少甲烷排放监管的计划，甲烷是气候变化的主要因素。

sentences.en: The White House has proposed eliminating federal requirements that oil and gas companies, which generate methane, install technology to detect leaks of it
sentences.zh: 白宫已提议取消联邦要求，即产生甲烷的石油和天然气公司必须安装技术来检测

sentences.en: from wells, pipelines, and storage facilities.
sentences.zh: 来自油井、管道和储存设施的甲烷泄漏。

sentences.en: But the Times reports that many energy companies oppose the change.
sentences.zh: 但《时报》报道称，许多能源公司反对这一改变。

sentences.en: Like several car companies, they have spoken in favor of existing environmental rules and are resisting attempts by the president to dismantle them.
sentences.zh: 就像几家汽车公司一样，他们曾发言支持现有的环境法规，并正在抵制总统试图废除这些法规的企图。

sentences.en: Forecasters are warning that Hurricane Dorian, a Category 1 storm now south of the Bahamas, could reach the east coast of Florida on Monday as a Category 4 storm,
sentences.zh: 预报员警告说，目前位于巴哈马群岛以南的一级风暴飓风“多利亚”可能会在周一以四级风暴的形式登陆佛罗里达州东海岸，

sentences.en: with winds of at least 130 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 风速至少达到每小时130英里。

sentences.en: The hurricane has spared Puerto Rico and could still stall out or change course before Monday.
sentences.zh: 这场飓风避开了波多黎各，在周一之前仍有可能停滞不前或改变路线。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。
